recognize_zh: CD3 染色中散在許多強陽性、膜狀著色的小型反應性 T 細胞，而背景成片的腫瘤細胞核呈藍色、不著色，表示腫瘤非 T 細胞來源。
features: Numerous scattered small lymphocytes with strong membranous CD3 staining
Positive T cells are evenly distributed between tumor cells, often in small clusters
Background sheet of larger tumor cells with round to oval nuclei is CD3-negative
describe_en: CD3 immunohistochemistry highlights a moderate number of scattered small reactive T cells distributed throughout the lesion. The larger neoplastic cells forming the background sheet are negative for CD3. This excludes a T-cell phenotype for the tumor population and, together with CD20 negativity and MUM1 positivity, supports a plasma cell neoplasm, consistent with EBV-positive plasmacytoma-like PTLD.

ddx.vs: In T-cell PTLD the atypical large cells themselves are CD3-positive, whereas here only small bystander cells stain.
THRLBCL has abundant T cells surrounding scattered large CD20+ B cells, whereas here the tumor sheet is CD20-negative and plasmacytic.
NK/T-cell lymphoma cells show cytoplasmic CD3ε with CD56, unlike the CD3-negative tumor cells here.
